subject: Activation crew hoodies — proofs, split-shipment options, and receiving constraints
messages:
From: Brass & Bolt Merch Co. <quotes@brassbolt.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: New proofs + preliminary packing ETA for activation crew hoodies

Hi Mateo / Laura,

Attached are the updated print specs and front/back proofs (swag_hoodie_v3_printspec.pdf, proof_front_back_v2.png). We made the logo placement adjustment on the left chest per your note and switched to the 320 gsm cotton blend you approved last week.

Quick summary:
- Total qty: 1,500 hoodies (mix detailed in packing_list_draft).
- Sizes: we show the original distribution but note XL currently shows 350 requested.
- Lead times: regular sea shipment for the full order is 12–18 business days after final sign-off; we can do a split (kitting + venue drop) with an initial 1,250 units by sea and the remaining by air.

Open questions for you before production:
1) Confirm final size breakdown (we still show 350 XL).
2) Confirm Pantone for the chest logo — the proof shows PANTONE 7457 C.
3) Any special customs labeling or bonded-warehouse paperwork for The Warehouse Venue (they listed as final destination).

If you can confirm today we can push a production slot this week. Attaching provisional invoice_337.pdf for the split-shipment estimate.

Thanks,
Erin Morales
Production Manager
Brass & Bolt Merch Co.
attachments: swag_hoodie_v3_printspec.pdf, proof_front_back_v2.png, invoice_337.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Brass & Bolt Merch Co. <quotes@brassbolt.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: New proofs + preliminary packing ETA for activation crew hoodies

Erin —

Thanks for the proofs. A few urgent items so we can lock sign-off and the production window:

- Size confirmation: we need to reduce XL from 350 to 250 (we have limited XL crew). Can you confirm if that creates a backorder and what the ETA is for the 100 XL shortfall if shipped separately?
- Pantone: PANTONE 7457 C is fine. Please include a swatch callout on the print spec PDF so our QA team can quickly confirm on arrival.
- Customs/receiving: The Warehouse Venue has special receiving hours and requires an itemized pallet manifest plus CBP-friendly description. I'll loop them in. Are you able to provide a commercial invoice with HS codes and a bonded-warehouse flag?

If a split shipment is the only way to meet our on-site timeline, please provide the cost delta for the air shipment of the 100 XL (door-to-venue). Also attach an updated packing list (packing_list_v2.xlsx) so we can confirm pallet counts.

Goal: final sign-off by EOD tomorrow so production can start Thursday.

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Events Logistics Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Brass & Bolt Merch Co. <quotes@brassbolt.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: New proofs + preliminary packing ETA for activation crew hoodies

Mateo —

Thanks for the quick note. Answers below and attached updated docs.

- XL backorder: cutting 100 XL from the main sea shipment is doable; we will ship 1,400 on the original sea schedule and air the 100 XL. ETA for the 100 XL via expedited air: 2026-07-08 (arrive local warehouse by EOD).
- Cost delta for air (100 XL, door-to-venue): $1,150 (see invoice_337.pdf line item "air expedite").
- Packing list: attached packing_list_v2.xlsx with pallet counts, net/gross weights, and HS codes.
- Commercial invoice: we can flag for bonded warehouse and include HS: 6101.30 (hoodies) on the final CI.

We also attached a version of the print spec with swatch callout (swag_hoodie_v3_printspec.pdf). Please confirm final size breakdown below so we can release to production:
- S: 200
- M: 450
- L: 500
- XL: 250
- XXL: 100

If you confirm, we will: 1) push to production Thursday night, 2) schedule sea pickup for 7/6 (arrival at local forwarder 7/16–7/20), and 3) book air for the 100 XL to arrive 7/8.

Erin Morales
Brass & Bolt Merch Co.
attachments: packing_list_v2.xlsx, invoice_337.pdf

From: The Warehouse Venue Receiving <ops@thewarehousevenue.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Brass & Bolt Merch Co. <quotes@brassbolt.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 10:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: New proofs + preliminary packing ETA for activation crew hoodies

Hi Mateo / Erin,

We can accept split deliveries and hold for event kitting, but a few receiving constraints to flag so there are no surprises:

- Receiving window: 2026-07-09, 08:00–16:00 local. If the air shipment arrives earlier, it must be scheduled to arrive within this window or we will assess arrival-handling fees.
- Documentation: we require a pallet manifest (PDF) and commercial invoice with HS codes and origin country. If you mark the shipment as "bonded for event use" please include the DoC statement.
- Palletization: standard 48x40 pallets. Please mark pallet 1 of N on the manifest. Loose cartons will be refused.
- Storage hold fee: first 48 hours free; after that, $45/day/pallet. We will waive storage fees for this order if the destination contact signs the attached release (DocuSign link provided).

We will be onsite to check inbound on 7/09 and can receive the 1,400 sea units plus the 100 air units if both arrive within the window. Please send the manifest and CI at least 24 hours prior.

Thanks,
Kendra Park
Receiving Manager
The Warehouse Venue
attachments: receiving_instructions_v1.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Brass & Bolt Merch Co. <quotes@brassbolt.com>, The Warehouse Venue Receiving <ops@thewarehousevenue.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 15:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: New proofs + preliminary packing ETA for activation crew hoodies

Kendra / Erin —

Understood and confirmed. Mateo here — we accept the revised size split (S200 / M450 / L500 / XL250 / XXL100) and will cover the $1,150 expedite cost for the 100 XL to guarantee on-site fit for crew.

Action items:
- Erin: please send the final CI + pallet manifest (PDF) and packing_list_v2.xlsx to ops@thewarehousevenue.com by 07/08 08:00 so they can clear receiving.
- Erin: please push production on 07/01 as discussed and confirm sea pickup 07/06.
- Kendra: we will sign the DocuSign release by EOD tomorrow once the manifest is uploaded.

Thanks everyone — will update the event ops doc once the manifest is uploaded to the drive link.

—Mateo
Events Logistics Lead | Redwood Inference
